text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: First the Satsuki Sho and then the Japanese Derby. And now, Mejiro Ryan wins the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The hope of the Mejiro family has taken all three legs of the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Triple Crown under her belt, Mejiro Ryan has achieved her dream of being successful in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huff…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Honestly, no… not at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It feels like I'm floating on a cloud. I can't believe it's real…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I mean, me? Beating McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Not only that, but beating Ines, too? Really… I really…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I really became the Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's like a dream. The whole spectacle of it. And all of the cheers…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Classics were my goal, of course. But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Every single race was a desperate struggle. I ran as fast as I could. Gave it my all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Even today at the Kikuka Sho… The fact that the Triple Crown depended on this race wasn't even in my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Still… today's win means so much to me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (I feel almost like I was able to show you I could hold my own.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think my heart has finally caught up with my body.
choice_data_list: So, you're feeling more confident now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I have a long way to go. There's still so much more to do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll work even harder from now on. Get bigger and stronger…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep! You should be more confident, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: C'mon, what's the star of the day still doing out here? You're gonna be late to the party!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Party? What party?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What party? The party where we celebrate you becoming Triple Crown champion, silly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, r-really?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (I still can't see what lies ahead of me, but I'll keep running and running.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (And one day, I'll be able to see it. I can believe that now!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fresh wind blows… toward the future, where unknown dreams await.
